about: R17's routing policy for study 4's d = 17 network d17_b5_r787 (PLAN_R17.md section 1). The threshold is the one the pre-stated C4.2 rule (ising_compare/arch/policy.py) chose on deep17's calibration set K17d for the registered artifact; deep17's readout recorded it at networks.D5reg.rule. Routing: a shot with |double(float32 c)| < tau goes to correlated PyMatching; any other shot is decided by c > 0.
rule: C4.2: the smallest q on G14's grid (0 and 1-30 %) with F_cal(q) <= M - 2 sqrt(2 M), M = round(0.90 x correlated PM's failures on the calibration set); if no q qualifies, the q with the fewest calibration failures (ties: the smaller q)
logits: the registered deploy tables through FROZEN (timing/engine.py, 4 pipeline stages) on the deep17 pod's H100; equal bit for bit on K17d to the refolded network (summary.json d5reg_consistency: 200,000 of 200,000)
